capabilities: Publish the current note to Steemit via a command
Configure Steemit credentials and verify them in settings
Set post metadata (tags, categories, permlink) through front matter
Exclude marked sections from publishing using HTML comments
extras: The README notes that the Steemit user must have the ability to create posts, and includes an example front-matter snippet.
problem: Obsidian notes are local Markdown files with no built-in way to post them to a Steemit blog.
summary: Publishing plugin that uploads the current note to Steemit as a post, with front-matter control over tags, categories and permlink.
